reasoning_notes.reasoning: A moderate opening rate balances winning the resource against per-unit profit while revealing nothing about future play.
With no history, bidding 20 guarantees the resource and earns zero; any lower rate risks earning nothing. This is a safe opening while I observe A’s behavior.
